## Personality

Posy Fay is known to kick while sleeping. Because of this habit, sharing a bed with her can be a notable inconvenience.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)_

## History

At three years old, Posy Fay suffered a severe bout of croup while her parents were away. Her older sister, [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), sought help at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to treat Posy Fay through the night until a doctor arrived and saved her life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031)_
